profile_text.body:
Micron Technology Inc. is a public company headquartered in Boise, Idaho, traded under the ticker MU, and registered with the SEC under CIK 0000723125. On its own site the company describes itself as a global leader in memory and storage, saying it powers AI and compute-intensive applications from cloud to edge with semiconductor solutions. It also states that mobile memory and storage accelerate AI-driven technologies for predictive and new end-user experiences.

The site's material is oriented toward customers and engineers rather than toward named AI products. It offers data sheets that can be searched, filtered, and downloaded, design tools and resources for testing, building, and maintaining high-performance solutions, technical documentation and downloads, a Technology Enablement Program (TEP) for enrollment, sales support contact, and an online source for placing and tracking orders for Micron memory samples.

Among the facts held about the company, its recorded litigation exposure sits in Idaho with a count of 21, and no individual cases are named. No products or MCP servers are listed for it.
